# Vue Star Rate (vue-js-star-rating)

> Zero-dependency Vue 3.5+ star rating component — WCAG 2.2 accessible, TypeScript-first, half-star precision, tree-shakeable lazy-loaded Lucide / FontAwesome / custom icons, SSR & Nuxt ready.

**Package:** `vue-js-star-rating` · **License:** MIT · **Peer:** `vue ^3.5.0` · **Bundle:** ~3 KB gzip (default SVG)

Vue Star Rate is the modern, accessibility-first star rating component for Vue 3 applications. Built with `<script setup>`, `defineModel`, `useTemplateRef`, and full TypeScript generics. Icon providers (Lucide, FontAwesome) load lazily via `defineAsyncComponent`, so consumers who pick the default SVG or a custom slot do not need to install `lucide-vue-next` or any FontAwesome runtime package.

## Quick start

```bash
pnpm add vue-js-star-rating
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { VueStarRate } from 'vue-js-star-rating';
import 'vue-js-star-rating/dist/style.css';
const rating = ref(0);
</script>

<template>
  <VueStarRate v-model="rating" :allow-half="true" :show-counter="true" />
</template>
```

## Props

- `v-model` (`number`, default `0`) — current rating value
- `maxStars` (`number`, default `5`)
- `allowHalf` (`boolean`, default `false`) — enable 0.5 increments
- `size` (`'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl'`, default `'md'`)
- `iconSize` (`number | { width, height }`) — override pixel size
- `iconProvider` (`'custom' | 'lucide' | 'fontawesome'`, default `'custom'`)
- `colors` (`Partial<StarColors>`) — `{ empty, filled, hover, half }`
- `animation` (`Partial<AnimationConfig>`) — `{ enabled, duration, type: 'scale'|'bounce'|'pulse'|'none' }`
- `readonly` (`boolean`, default `false`)
- `disabled` (`boolean`, default `false`)
- `clearable` (`boolean`, default `false`)
- `allowReset` (`boolean`, default `true`) — click active star again to reset
- `showCounter` / `counterTemplate` (default template `'{value} / {max}'`)
- `showTooltip` / `tooltipLabels` (`string[]`)
- `minRating` (`number`, default `0`) / `step` (`number`, default `1`)
- `rtl` (`boolean`) / `inline` (`boolean`) / `gap` (`number`, px)
- `ariaLabel` (`string`, default `'Star rating'`) / `className` / `faIcons` / `customIcon`

## Events

- `update:modelValue` (`number`) — emitted by `v-model`
- `change` (`value`, `oldValue`)
- `hover` (`number | null`)
- `focus` / `blur`

## Slots

- `icon` — scoped: `{ filled, half, size, color, index }`
- `counter` — scoped: `{ value, max }`
- `clear` — content of the clear button

## Keyboard

- `→` / `↑` — increase · `←` / `↓` — decrease
- `Home` — minimum · `End` — maximum
- `1`–`9` — jump to value · `0` — reset

## Exposed methods

`reset()`, `setRating(value)`, `getRating()`, `focus()`, `blur()`

## Optional peers

- `lucide-vue-next` — only required when `iconProvider="lucide"` is rendered
- `@fortawesome/fontawesome-free` (CSS) — only required when `iconProvider="fontawesome"` is rendered
